bio.p1: I am Raquel Antúnez Durán, the creator of this studio where art is woven slowly, with intention and soul.
bio.p2: My creative universe is born from a sensitive gaze towards the beauty of everyday life. For years I have told stories through photography, words and voice: capturing light, emotion and the essence of each instant. My work has always been guided by the same intention: to connect with the authentic and transform the invisible into something that can be felt.
bio.p3: That same sensitivity lives today in every piece I create with my hands. I come from a lineage of spinners, of women who understood the value of time, care and small gestures. From there comes my way of creating: as an intimate ritual, unhurried and full of meaning.
bio.p4: In this space I bring to life micramé pieces and handcrafted jewelry woven by hand with waxed thread, natural stones and materials chosen with care and awareness. Each necklace, bracelet, anklet or amulet is designed to accompany you, to remind you of something important or simply to make you feel closer to yourself.
bio.p5: I am inspired by nature and the delicacy of the imperfect. The silent energy of minerals. And the certainty that objects can also hold memory, intention and emotion. More than accessories, here you will find small stories woven thread by thread — made to last, to accompany, to never be forgotten.
bio.title: A story woven by hand

care.ctaText: Do you have any questions about caring for your piece?
care.title: Piece Care Guide
care.intro: Macramé is a textile art that, with proper care, can stay beautiful for a very long time. Follow these recommendations to keep your piece in its best condition.

sections.title: 1. Cleaning
sections.content: If your piece needs cleaning, hand washing with cold or warm water and mild soap is the best option. Avoid machine washing or using harsh detergents that can damage the fibers. Let it dry in the shade, laid flat or hanging, without wringing it out.

sections.title: 2. Sun and moisture exposure
sections.content: Avoid prolonged exposure to direct sunlight, as it can fade natural fibers. Similarly, store your pieces in dry, well-ventilated places to prevent moisture or mold from forming.

sections.title: 3. Storage
sections.content: If you are not going to use your piece for a while, fold it carefully or roll it gently and store it in a breathable fabric bag. Avoid sealed plastic bags that retain moisture and do not allow the material to breathe.

sections.title: 4. Repairs
sections.content: If over time a knot loosens or a fiber gets damaged, you can contact us to arrange a repair. We love our creations and want them to keep accompanying you.

sections.title: 5. The uniqueness of your piece
sections.content: Every Mimacramé Studio creation is one of a kind. Natural materials present variations in tone, texture, and finish that make each piece different from any other. These differences are not imperfections — they are the signature of handmade craft. For this reason, we do not process exchanges or returns for variations inherent to natural materials. Each piece is, in itself, an unrepeatable work of art.

privacy.ctaText: Want to exercise your rights or have questions about your data?
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Mimacramé Studio, we take the privacy and security of your data very seriously. This policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your information.

sections.title: 1. Data we collect
sections.content: We collect the information you provide when placing an order, such as your name, email address, shipping address, and phone number. We do not store credit card data; all payments are processed securely through our payment providers (Stripe).

sections.title: 2. Use of information
sections.content: We use your data exclusively to manage and ship your orders, send you confirmations, or contact you if there is an issue with your purchase.

sections.title: 3. Protection of your data
sections.content: Your personal data is kept securely and is never sold or given to third parties for marketing purposes. We only share your address with the courier companies necessary to deliver your order.

sections.title: 4. Your rights

shipping.ctaText: Do you have questions about your shipping or want to process a return?
shipping.title: Shipping & Returns
shipping.intro: Every Mimacramé Studio piece is carefully prepared before it reaches you. Here you will find all the information about delivery times, costs, and what to do if something goes wrong.

sections.title: 1. Preparation time
sections.content: Each piece is handmade to order. Preparation time is 5 to 10 business days from payment confirmation. During peak seasons (special dates, holidays) this may be extended; we will let you know at the time of purchase.

sections.title: 2. Shipping
sections.content: We ship nationwide. The cost and delivery time depend on your location and the selected courier service. Shipping costs are calculated automatically at checkout. Once dispatched, you will receive a tracking number to follow your order.

sections.title: 3. International shipping
sections.content: At the moment we only ship within the national territory. If you are abroad and would like to purchase a piece, feel free to contact us so we can explore options together.

sections.title: 4. Return policy
sections.contentBefore: Due to the artisanal, made-to-order nature of each piece, we do not accept returns or exchanges. Every creation is unique and crafted especially for you. If you received a damaged piece or one that does not match your order, write to us at
sections.contentAfter: with your order number and we will take care of it.

sections.title: 5. Artisan pieces and natural variations
sections.content: Each Mimacramé Studio piece is unique and handmade with natural materials. Variations in color, texture, or size compared to the photos are not defects — they are the essence of handmade craft. For this reason, we do not accept returns or exchanges based on differences inherent to natural materials. At the time of purchase, you can indicate your material preferences so the artisan can take them into account.
